daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿فَكُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿غَنِمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿حَلالًا﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "أكلا حلالا" (a lawful eating); or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿طَيِّباً﴾ adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to فكلوا.. [Translator's note: the source says "past verb"; اتقوا here is an imperative verb.] ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is causal.

daas-irab:70-70.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ a genitive noun (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْأَسْرى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The verbal clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿يَعْلَمِ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُؤْتِكُمْ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is "هو", and the kāf is its first object. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ its second object. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to خيرا. ﴿أُخِذَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "هو". ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَيَغْفِرْ﴾ conjoined to يؤتكم, jussive like it.
﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور رحيم are two khabars (predicates); the nominal clause is resumptive. إن يعلم and what follows it is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said), and the clause يؤتكم has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that puts the verb in the jussive and not joined to the fāʾ or to إذا.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ إن is conditional. ﴿يُرِيدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿خِيانَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿قد﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خانُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the construct, in the position of genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun منهم are attached; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it are its two khabars (predicates). The clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:72-72.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَهاجَرُوا وَجاهَدُوا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿بِأَمْوالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آوَوْا وَنَصَرُوا..﴾ the clause الذين آووا is conjoined, the clause آمنوا is the ṣila, and the clause ونصروا is conjoined. [Translator's note: so in the source; the ṣila in this phrase is آووا.] ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of nominative as the first mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ second mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلِياءُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of بعضهم. ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause بعضهم أولياء is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك بعضهم.. is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يُهاجِرُوا﴾ the clauses are conjoined. ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾ ما is negating, without governing effect. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ شيء. ﴿مِنْ وَلايَتِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. شيء is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the relative noun. ﴿حَتَّى يُهاجِرُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from the latent أن after حتى and the imperfect verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the negating ما, which carries the meaning of a verb, i.e. "their guardianship over them is negated".. ﴿وَإِنِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is conditional. ﴿اسْتَنْصَرُوكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined.
﴿فَعَلَيْكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar, and the fāʾ is linking. ﴿النَّصْرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عَلى قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted excepted (mustathnā), i.e. "إلا النصر على قوم" (except help against a people)..
﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿وَبَيْنَهُمْ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿مِيثاقٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and together with the imperfect verb it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ second mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلِياءُ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause بعضهم أولياء بعض is the khabar of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is conjoined to the clause (الذين آووا ونصروا) in the previous verse. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ composed of إن, a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive, and ﴿لا﴾, the negating lā. ﴿تَفْعَلُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) has no grammatical position, being initial. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكن. ﴿وَفَسادٌ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ adjective (ṣifa). The clause of the apodosis has no grammatical position, not being joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise.

daas-irab:74-74.t:
«وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا..» its i'rab is like the i'rab of verse 72. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative, on the view that هم is a pronoun of separation..
The nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ at the beginning of the verse.
﴿حَقًّا﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَرِزْقٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾ adjective (ṣifa); the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:75-75.t: والذين آمنوا.. like the i'rab of the preceding one. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). The fāʾ is linking, because of the resemblance to a condition contained in the relative noun. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the relative noun. ﴿وَأُولُوا﴾ mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَرْحامِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلى﴾ its khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar أولى. The nominal clause بعضهم أولى ببعض is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولو, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي كِتابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar: "هذا منزّل في كتاب الله" (this is sent down in the Book of Allah). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾, and ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its mafʿūl (object). ﴿عَنِ الْأَنْفالِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", i.e. the Prophet, Allah's blessings be upon him; the clause is resumptive.
﴿الْأَنْفالِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and both are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالرَّسُولِ﴾: conjoined; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاتَّقُوا﴾: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and its fāʿil; and الله, the Name of Majesty, is its mafʿūl. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَأَصْلِحُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿ذاتَ﴾: its mafʿūl. ﴿بَيْنِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined.
﴿وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun; the apodosis is omitted because what precedes indicates it..

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb in the passive, and the Name of Majesty is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿تُلِيَتْ﴾: a past verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿آياتُهُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿زادَتْهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿إِيماناً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَعَلى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute), and the verbal clause ﴿يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive governed by من. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بينفقون﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source, i.e. to the verb يُنْفِقُونَ.]»; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t:
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate); or هم is a nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ, and المؤمنون its khabar, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "المؤمنون إيمانا حقا" (the believers with a true belief).
﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar. ﴿دَرَجاتٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣifa of درجات. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).. ﴿وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾: ṣifa.

daas-irab:5-5.t:
﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿أَخْرَجَكَ﴾: a past verb, and the kāf is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ بَيْتِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ما and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive governed by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿وَإِنَّ فَرِيقاً﴾: inna and its noun, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of فريقا. ﴿لَكارِهُونَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يُجادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to the verb. ﴿ما تَبَيَّنَ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿كَأَنَّما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُساقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَى الْمَوْتِ﴾ are attached. The wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause ينظرون is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ is circumstantial.

daas-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb "اذكروا" (remember); the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يَعِدُكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the kāf is its first object and الله, the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِحْدَى﴾: its second object. ﴿الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿أَنَّها﴾: anna and its noun.
﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); أن with its noun and its khabar is, by interpretation, a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) from إحدى. ﴿وَتَوَدُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) after the wāw of circumstance. ﴿أَنَّ غَيْرَ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿ذاتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الشَّوْكَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أن, and أن with its noun and its khabar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُحِقَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar is its mafʿūl. ﴿بِكَلِماتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause is conjoined to the clause يعدكم. And likewise the clause ﴿وَيَقْطَعَ دابِرَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿لِيُحِقَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: "فعل الله هذا" (Allah did this).. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «[Translator's note: so in the source, with the word written with ḍamma; as object it is الْحَقَّ.]» ﴿وَيُبْطِلَ الْباطِلَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: لو is the connective (waṣliyya) لو, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). And the clause ﴿كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ is circumstantial.

daas-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إِذْ﴾: a badal (substitute) from وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ, or attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted اذكر (remember).
﴿تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَاسْتَجابَ لَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ are attached, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنِّي﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿مُمِدُّكُمْ﴾: its khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to استجاب. ﴿بِأَلْفٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle ممدكم. ﴿مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ألف. ﴿مُرْدِفِينَ﴾: a ṣifa of ألف.

daas-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وَما﴾: negating, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿بُشْرى﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَما﴾: ما is negating and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿النَّصْرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ﴾: inna, the Name of Majesty its noun and عزيز its khabar. ﴿حَكِيمٌ﴾: a second khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: a second badal (substitute) from His saying (وإذ يعدكم..). ﴿يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعاسَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; its fāʿil (agent) is "هو", the kāf is its first object and النعاس its second object. ﴿أَمَنَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of أمنة. The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَيُنَزِّلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and likewise ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ is also attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ماءً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ينزل. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يطهركم. ﴿وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطانِ.. وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدامَ﴾: the clauses are conjoined.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) يثبت, or a third badal (substitute). ﴿يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and ربك is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ﴾: anna and its noun; معكم is an adverb of place, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, its noun and its khabar is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, or in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يوحي. ﴿فَثَبِّتُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَأُلْقِي﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الرُّعْبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَاضْرِبُوا﴾: like فثبتوا.. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَعْناقِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاضْرِبُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from بنان, which comes after them. The clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَنانٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:13-13.t:
«[Translator's note: the source text of this entry is damaged — the Quranic brackets are lost and the first letter of several words is missing (e.g. "لِكَ" for ذلِكَ, "ِأَنَّهُمْ" for بِأَنَّهُمْ). The intended Quranic words have been restored inside ﴿…﴾ below.]»
﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; and the verbal clause ﴿شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: conjoined; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, its noun and its khabar [with the bāʾ] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُشاقِقِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and given a kasra to prevent the meeting of two sukūns; the nominal clause من يشاقق is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis with its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "ذلكم العقاب" (that is the punishment); it may also be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَذُوقُوهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, with its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنَّ لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذابَ﴾: anna and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar.
﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:15-15.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; and ها is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute). «[Translator's note: so in the source; الذين after أيها is usually said to be in the position of the nominative.]» ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِذا﴾: adverbial (ẓarfiyya), conditional, non-jussive. ﴿لَقِيتُمُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil, and the mīm is for the plural; the relative noun is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause (كفروا is the ṣila. ﴿زَحْفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فَلا﴾: لا is the prohibitive لا, governing the jussive, and the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿تُوَلُّوهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its first object. ﴿الْأَدْبارَ﴾: its second object. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

daas-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿يُوَلِّهِمْ﴾: يول is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the weak letter from its end; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time annexed to an adverb of time. ﴿دُبُرَهُ﴾: its second object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) or exception. ﴿مُتَحَرِّفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, or the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿لِقِتالٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) متحرفا. The nominal clause ومن.... is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزاً﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِلى فِئَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متحيزا. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿باءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿بِغَضَبٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by من; both are attached to غضب; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وَمَأْواهُ﴾: مأوى is a mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جَهَنَّمُ﴾: khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: fāʿil; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "مصيرهم" (their destination). The clause بئس المصير is in the position of the nominative as khabar of this omitted mubtadaʾ. And the nominal clause مصيرهم بئس المصير is resumptive.

daas-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فَلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿تَقْتُلُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, with its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: lākinna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the verbal clause ﴿قَتَلَهُمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ولكن الله.. is conjoined.
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿رَمَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it, and the clause ﴿رَمَيْتَ﴾ after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); likewise the clause ﴿لكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is conjoined.
﴿رَمى﴾: the clause is the khabar of لكن. ﴿وَلِيُبْلِيَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, i.e. "فعل الله هذا" (Allah did this).. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ, a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from بلاء. ﴿بَلاءً﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and ﴿حَسَناً﴾ is a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾: inna, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:18-18.t: ﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "ذلكم حق" (that is the truth); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ﴾: anna, the Name of Majesty its noun and موهن its khabar. ﴿كَيْدِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْكافِرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ in place of the kasra, a sound masculine plural. أن with its noun and its khabar is, by interpretation, a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to what precedes it, i.e. "ذلكم حق وتوهين كيد الكافرين حق" (that is the truth, and the weakening of the plotting of the disbelievers is the truth)..

daas-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿تَسْتَفْتِحُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جاءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ﴾: a past verb, its mafʿūl (object) and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and likewise وإن ﴿تَنْتَهُوا﴾. ﴿فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ﴾: the clause is in the position of [the jussive as] the apodosis. «[Translator's note: the word "jussive" (جزم) is missing in the source.]» ﴿وَإِنْ تَعُودُوا﴾: its i'rab is like the preceding. ﴿نَعُدْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis. ﴿وَلَنْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لن governs the subjunctive. ﴿تُغْنِيَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿فِئَتُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿شَيْئاً﴾: a substitute for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
لو is a non-jussive conditional. ﴿كَثُرَتْ﴾: a past verb; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the adverb ﴿مَعَ﴾ is attached to its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). أن with its noun and its khabar is, by interpretation, a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, i.e. "ولأن الله مع المؤمنين" (and because Allah is with the believers).

daas-irab:20-20.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: for its i'rab see verse 15. ﴿أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: see the first verse. ﴿وَلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and لا is the prohibitive لا, governing the jussive. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولوا; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). And the clause ﴿تَسْمَعُونَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). The nominal clause وأنتم تسمعون is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وَلا﴾: the prohibitive لا, governing the jussive, and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿تَكُونُوا﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as its noun. ﴿كَالَّذِينَ﴾: the kāf is a preposition, and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); or the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), which is the khabar, and the relative noun is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The verbal clause ﴿قالُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَهُمْ لا يَسْمَعُونَ﴾: like His saying, the Exalted, وأنتم تسمعون in the previous verse.

daas-irab:22-22.t: ﴿إِنَّ شَرَّ﴾: inna and its noun. ﴿الدَّوَابِّ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative (ism al-tafḍīl) شر. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الصُّمُّ﴾: first khabar (predicate). ﴿الْبُكْمُ﴾: second khabar. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as a ṣifa (adjective), and the clause ﴿لا يَعْقِلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The nominal clause إن شر.. is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:23-23.t: ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿عَلِمَ اللَّهُ فِيهِمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq), and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿خَيْراً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَأَسْمَعَهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the lām occurs in the apodosis, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the clause ﴿وَلَوْ أَسْمَعَهُمْ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿لَتَوَلَّوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, and the lām likewise links the apodosis. The nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:24-24.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: see verse 15. ﴿اسْتَجِيبُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَلِلرَّسُولِ﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb attached to استجيبوا, and the clause استجيبوا is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿دَعاكُمْ﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; its fāʿil is "هو" and the kāf its mafʿūl (object). The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
﴿لِما﴾: the lām is a preposition; ما is a relative noun in the position of the genitive governed by the lām. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to دعاكم. ما may also be parsed as maṣdariyya. ﴿يُحْيِيكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; its fāʿil is "هو", the kāf is its mafʿūl, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾: like استجيبوا, and it is conjoined to it. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿يَحُولُ﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿بَيْنَ﴾: an adverb attached to يحول. ﴿الْمَرْءِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَقَلْبِهِ﴾: conjoined. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, its noun and its khabar stands in place of the two objects of علم. ﴿وَأَنَّهُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ﴾: the second interpreted maṣdar is conjoined. And ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ is attached to the verb ﴿تُحْشَرُونَ﴾. The clause تحشرون is the khabar.

daas-irab:25-25.t: ﴿وَاتَّقُوا﴾: an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined to استجيبوا. ﴿فِتْنَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لا تُصِيبَنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and لا is negating with no governing effect. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ṣifa (adjective). ﴿ظَلَمُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿خَاصَّةً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾: conjoined to اتقوا. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, its noun and its khabar (predicate) stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وَاذْكُرُوا﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿قَلِيلٌ﴾: first khabar (predicate). ﴿مُسْتَضْعَفُونَ﴾: second khabar, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مستضعفون. ﴿تَخافُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is a third khabar. ﴿أَنْ يَتَخَطَّفَكُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿النَّاسُ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿فَآواكُمْ﴾: آوى is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَأَيَّدَكُمْ بِنَصْرِهِ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached; the fāʿil is "هو" and the kāf its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَرَزَقَكُمْ مِنَ الطَّيِّباتِ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾: laʿalla, and the kāf is its noun, and the clause ﴿تَشْكُرُونَ﴾ is its khabar. The clause لعلكم is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:27-27.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: it has preceded in verse 15. ﴿لا تَخُونُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿اللَّهَ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿وَالرَّسُولَ﴾: conjoined.
﴿تَخُونُوا﴾: conjoined to the first تخونوا; or the wāw is the wāw of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and تخونوا is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the wāw of accompaniment, the sign of its accusative being the deletion of the nūn. ﴿أَماناتِكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa.
The kāf is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). And the nominal clause ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial)..

daas-irab:28-28.t:
﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾:
the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنَّما﴾:
the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَمْوالُكُمْ﴾:
mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَأَوْلادُكُمْ﴾:
conjoined. ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾:
khabar (predicate); the nominal clause stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾:
anna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾:
an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿أَجْرٌ﴾:
a postponed mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أن. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾:
ṣifa (adjective). The clause اعلموا is conjoined.

daas-irab:29-29.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾: its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional. ﴿تَتَّقُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is an attached pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يَجْعَلْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجعل. ﴿فُرْقاناً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَيُكَفِّرْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the apodosis; the accusative is also permissible in it, by an implied أن,
and the nominative as a resumption. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿سَيِّئاتِكُمْ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the clause is conjoined. And likewise the clause ﴿وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ﴾. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿ذُو﴾: khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is one of the five nouns. ﴿الْفَضْلِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْعَظِيمِ﴾: ṣifa (adjective); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb اذكر (remember); the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَمْكُرُ بِكَ الَّذِينَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the relative noun after it is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). And the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿لِيُثْبِتُوكَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb يمكر. ﴿أَوْ يَقْتُلُوكَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿أَوْ يُخْرِجُوكَ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَيَمْكُرُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَيَمْكُرُ اللَّهُ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ خَيْرُ﴾: the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and خير its khabar (predicate). ﴿الْماكِرِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وَإِذا﴾: an adverb for future time, containing the meaning of condition. ﴿تُتْلى﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿آياتُنا﴾ «[Translator's note: the opening bracket of this word is missing in the source.]»: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation.
﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿قَدْ﴾: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿سَمِعْنا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لَوْ﴾: a non-jussive conditional particle. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is "نحن"; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿لَقُلْنا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis. ﴿قلنا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. ﴿مِثْلَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi, accusative. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿إِنْ﴾: negating. ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَساطِيرُ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: conjoined to the previous verses. ﴿قالُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿اللَّهُمَّ﴾: the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; the doubled mīm replaces the omitted vocative yāʾ. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional particle. ﴿كانَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as its noun.
﴿هُوَ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْحَقَّ﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from الحق; the clause is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَأَمْطِرْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a verb of supplication to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ are attached; its fāʿil is "أنت". ﴿حِجارَةً﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of حجارة; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿أَوِ﴾: a conjunction. ﴿ائْتِنا﴾: a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the deletion of the weak letter, the yāʾ; نا is an attached pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿بِعَذابٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿أَلِيمٍ﴾: ṣifa; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:33-33.t: ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: negating. ﴿كانَ اللَّهُ﴾: kāna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لِيُعَذِّبَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural. The interpreted maṣdar formed from the implied أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَأَنْتَ﴾: a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿فِيهِمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَما كانَ اللَّهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ﴾: the nominal clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl, and the clause ﴿يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ﴾ is the khabar.

daas-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a particle governing the subjunctive. «[Translator's note: so in the source, "إن"; the particle in the verse is أَلَّا, i.e. أنْ + لا.]» ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿يُعَذِّبَهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl (object); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿يَصُدُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَنِ الْمَسْجِدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿الْحَرامِ﴾: ṣifa (adjective). The verbal clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, and ما is negating. ﴿كانُوا أَوْلِياءَهُ﴾: kāna, its noun and its khabar; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إِنْ﴾: negating. ﴿أَوْلِياؤُهُ﴾: mubtadaʾ, nominative by the ḍamma, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). «[Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿أَلَّا﴾; the word in the verse is إِلَّا.]» ﴿الْمُتَّقُونَ﴾: khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾: a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَكْثَرَهُمْ﴾: its noun. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; لا is negating; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of لكن, and the nominal clause ولكن أكثرهم.. is circumstantial.

daas-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a particle of resumption; ما is negating. ﴿كانَ صَلاتُهُمْ﴾: kāna and its noun. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from صلاتهم. ﴿الْبَيْتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مُكاءً﴾: khabar (predicate). ﴿وَتَصْدِيَةً﴾: conjoined.
﴿فَذُوقُوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿ذوقوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْعَذابَ﴾: its mafʿūl (object); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿بِما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: kāna, the tāʾ is its noun and the mīm for the masculine plural; the interpreted maṣdar formed from the incomplete verb and the verb after it with the maṣdariyya ما is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, i.e. "because of your disbelief". The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb ذوقوا, and the clause ﴿تَكْفُرُونَ﴾ is the khabar.

daas-irab:36-36.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ﴾: inna and its noun, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause إن الذين is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ أَمْوالَهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate) of inna. ﴿لِيَصُدُّوا﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ينفقون. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصدوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَسَيُنْفِقُونَها﴾: the fāʾ is a particle of resumption. ﴿يُنْفِقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿ثُمَّ تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, its noun a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring to الأموال (the wealth). ﴿حَسْرَةً﴾: its khabar. The preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from حسرة, because it comes after it «[Translator's note: so in the source; عليهم actually follows حسرة in the verse.]»; the clause is conjoined, and likewise the clause ﴿ثُمَّ يُغْلَبُونَ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا﴾: conjoined to الذين at the beginning of the verse. ﴿إِلى جَهَنَّمَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb يحشرون. جهنم is genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra, because of being a proper noun and foreign; and the clause ﴿يُحْشَرُونَ﴾ is the khabar.

daas-irab:37-37.t: ﴿لِيَمِيزَ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb يغلبون. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent). ﴿الْخَبِيثَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مِنَ الطَّيِّبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الخبيث. ﴿وَيَجْعَلَ الْخَبِيثَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿بَعْضَهُ﴾: badal (substitute), accusative. ﴿عَلى بَعْضٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from بعضه. ﴿فَيَرْكُمَهُ﴾: conjoined to يجعل. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾: ḥāl. ﴿فَيَجْعَلَهُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾: a noun, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُمُ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿الْخاسِرُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:38-38.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾: the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive particle. ﴿يَنْتَهُوا﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿يُغْفَرْ﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the verbal clause قد سلف is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَإِنْ يَعُودُوا﴾: like إن ينتهوا..; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَقَدْ مَضَتْ سُنَّتُ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.

daas-irab:39-39.t:
﴿وَقاتِلُوهُمْ﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿حَتَّى﴾: a particle of limit (ghāya) and a preposition. ﴿لا﴾: negating. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾: a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb meaning "occur" (تقع), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb قاتلوهم. ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾: fāʿil; and the clause قاتلوهم is conjoined to the clause قل..
﴿وَيَكُونَ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb. ﴿الدِّينُ﴾: its noun. ﴿كُلُّهُ﴾: tawkīd (emphasis), nominative. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the incomplete verb; the clause is conjoined.
﴿فَإِنِ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿إن﴾: a conditional particle. ﴿انْتَهَوْا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
﴿فَإِنِ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and إن is a particle resembling the verb. «[Translator's note: so in the source, written ﴿فَإِنِ﴾; the word in the verse is فَإِنَّ.]» ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿بِما﴾: ما is maṣdariyya or a relative, in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar, taking ما as maṣdariyya, is in the position of the genitive governed by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar. ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾: khabar.

dervis-irab:10-11.t:
* I'rab:
(وَما جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرى): the wāw is resumptive, or conjunctive joining to what preceded; ما is negating; جعله الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); the pronoun refers back to the reinforcement (al-imdād); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); بشرى is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), excepted from the most general of causes. (وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ بِهِ قُلُوبُكُمْ): the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is causal (li-l-taʿlīl); تطمئن is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb) by an أن implied after it; the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to بشرى. The object of purpose is put in the genitive with the lām here because a condition for the accusative is missing, namely identity of the agent; قلوبكم is the fāʿil of تطمئنّ. (وَمَا النَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ): the wāw is resumptive, or also circumstantial; ما is negating; النصر is a mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; من عند الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). (إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ): the nominal clause gives the reason for what preceded. (إِذْ يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعاسَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ): إذ is an adverb, a badal (substitute) for إذ يعدكم; it is the second badal, as mentioned before. The clause يغشيكم النعاس is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); النعاس is a mafʿūl bihi; أمنة is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi; منه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمنة. (وَيُنَزِّلُ عَلَيْكُمْ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ بِهِ): ينزل is conjoined to يغشيكم; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ينزل, and likewise من السماء; ماء is a mafʿūl bihi; ليطهركم: the lām is causal and يطهركم is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an أن implied after it; به is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يطهركم. (وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطانِ وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدامَ): clauses conjoined to what preceded. The pronoun in به refers to the water, so that walking on the sand becomes easy, since walking on it is usually difficult, but when water falls on it, it becomes firm and walking on it becomes easy. It is also said that the pronoun refers to the strengthening (al-rabṭ), because when patience and boldness are firmly established in the heart, the feet are made firm in the places of battle.

dervis-irab:12-14.t:
* Vocabulary:
(البنان): the fingers, as in al-Miṣbāḥ, or their tips; the singular is بنانة.
Abū al-Haytham said: البنان means the joints, and every joint is a بنانة. It is also said: البنان means the fingers of the hands and the feet, and all the joints of every limb.
(شاقُّوا) [Translator's note: the opening of this headword is damaged in the source text («َاقُّوا)»); it is the word شاقّوا of the ayah.]: they opposed. المشاقّة is derived from الشقّ (side, split), because each of two enemies is on a side (ʿudwa) other than the side of his fellow; and likewise المخاصمة, because this one is in one خصم, i.e. on one side, and that one in another خصم.

* I'rab:
(إِذْ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ): the adverb may be a third badal (substitute) for إذ يعدكم; it may also be in the accusative governed by يثبت, or be governed by an omitted verb, i.e. «اذكر» (remember). The clause يوحي ربك is in the position of a genitive by annexation; إلى الملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) يوحي; أني together with what falls in its scope is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يوحي; معكم is an adverb attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of أني. (فَثَبِّتُوا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that reveals an omitted condition), i.e. if this is established, then make firm those who believe by giving them glad tidings of victory; الذين is a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause آمنوا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. (سَأُلْقِي فِي قُلُوبِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعْبَ):
the clause may be an explanation of His saying:
إني معكم فثبتوا, for there is no help more emphatic and more effective than casting terror into the hearts of the enemies; or it may be resumptive. In both cases it has no grammatical position. في قلوب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ألقي; الرعب is the mafʿūl bihi of ألقي; the clause كفروا has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the relative noun. (فَاضْرِبُوا فَوْقَ الْأَعْناقِ وَاضْرِبُوا مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنانٍ): an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); فوق is an adverb attached to اضربوا, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e. "so strike them above the necks". «فوق» may also be a mafʿūl bihi by extension of usage (ʿalā al-ittisāʿ), because it denotes the head.
It is as if it were said: "so strike above their heads", and this is what al-Zamakhsharī chose. He said:
«He meant the upper parts of the necks, which are the places of slaughter, because they are joints, so that a blow landing there would be a cutting through and a sending of heads flying. And it is said: He meant the heads, because they are above the necks, meaning a striking of the skulls. ʿAmr ibn al-Iṭnāba said:
أبت لي عفّتي وأبى بلائي ... وأخذي الحمد بالثمن الربيح
وإقدامي على المكروه نفسي ... وضربي هامة البطل المشيح
لأدفع عن مآثر صالحات ... وأحجب بعد عن عرض صحيح
(Gloss: My chastity refused it for me, and my prowess, and my winning praise at a profitable price, and my pressing my own self forward into what is hateful, and my striking the skull of the wary champion — so that I might defend noble deeds of glory and then shield a sound honour.)
[Translator's note: the source has «لأن نها» in this quotation, evidently a misprint for «لأنها» (because they are); translated accordingly. The source also does not mark where al-Zamakhsharī's quotation ends.]
(ذلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ) [Translator's note: the opening of this ayah segment is damaged in the source («لِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ…»).]:
the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the reference is to what befell them of striking, killing and punishment; بأنهم is its khabar; the clause شاقّوا الله ورسوله is the khabar of أنّ; the Name of Majesty (Allah) is a mafʿūl bihi, and رسوله is conjoined to it.
(وَمَنْ يُشاقِقِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقابِ) [Translator's note: the opening of this ayah segment is also damaged in the source («َ مَنْ يُشاقِقِ…»).]:
the wāw is resumptive; من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; يشاقون [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the ayah is يشاقق] is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); إنّ, its noun and its khabar [form the apodosis]; the protasis and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) are the khabar of «من». The conditional sentence here is a completion of what came before it and a repetition of its content. (ذلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذابَ النَّارِ): the demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ; the address is to the disbelievers by way of iltifāt (sudden shift of address); the khabar is omitted, its implied form being "the punishment". You may also parse the demonstrative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.:
"the punishment is that"; it may also be in the position of an accusative by ishtighāl (a noun whose verb is occupied with its pronoun), as when you say:
زيدا فاضربه ("Zayd — strike him"). In every case the fāʾ is resumptive and ذوقوه is a resumptive statement. أنّ is conjoined to ذلكم under all three of its analyses; للكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of «أنّ», placed first; عذاب النار is its noun, placed after. The meaning is: taste this immediate punishment together with the deferred one.

* Rhetoric:
In these ayat there are numerous devices of rhetoric, to which we alluded during the i'rab because of their connection with it: majāz (figurative usage), iltifāt (shift of address), and istiʿāra (metaphor) in His saying «فذقوه» [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah reads فذوقوه]. These devices have been discussed before in their places.

dervis-irab:15-18.t:
* Vocabulary:
(زَحْفاً): الزحف is the maṣdar (verbal noun) of زحف. In al-Miṣbāḥ: زحف القوم زحفا (the people advanced), of the pattern of نفع, and also زحوفا. A large army is called زحف, naming it by the maṣdar; the plural is زحوف, like فلس and فلوس. And a child زحف on the ground (crawls) before he walks.
(مُتَحَرِّفاً): turning aside; or it is attacking again after retreating, so as to make the enemy imagine that one has been routed, then turning back on him. It is one of the ruses and stratagems of war.
(مُتَحَيِّزاً): withdrawing to join, gathering oneself to. التحيّز and التحوّز mean joining up (al-inḍimām); تحوّزت الحية: the snake coiled itself up; حزت الشيء: I gathered the thing to me; الحوزة is what gathers things together. The original form of متحيّز is متحيوز: the yāʾ and the wāw came together, the first of them being vowelless, so the wāw was changed into a yāʾ and the yāʾ was assimilated into the yāʾ.

* I'rab:
(يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): its i'rab has been given many times before. (إِذا لَقِيتُمُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا زَحْفاً فَلا تُوَلُّوهُمُ الْأَدْبارَ): إذا is an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition; the clause لقيتم is in the position of a genitive by annexation; الذين is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause); زحفا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين, i.e. while they are advancing. It is also said: «زحفا» is in the accusative as a maṣdar governed by an omitted ḥāl, i.e. زاحفين زحفا (advancing an advance). This that has been said is muḥkam [i.e. firmly established, not abrogated], so fleeing at the encounter is forbidden in every case. The fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa); لا is prohibitive; تولوهم is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by لا; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi, and الأدبار is a second mafʿūl bihi. (وَمَنْ يُوَلِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ دُبُرَهُ):
the wāw is resumptive; من is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); يولهم is a verb, its latent (mustatir) agent and its first object; دبره is the second object of يولهم; يومئذ is an adverb annexed to an adverb, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يولهم. (إِلَّا مُتَحَرِّفاً لِقِتالٍ أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزاً إِلى فِئَةٍ): «إلا» may be a particle of restriction because of the preceding prohibition, and متحرفا is a ḥāl; or «إلا» may be a particle of exception, and متحرفا is excepted from the pronoun of the believers. لقتال is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to «متحرفا»; أو متحيزا إلى فئة is conjoined to what precedes it. (فَقَدْ باءَ بِغَضَبٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ): the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) because the apodosis is joined with قد; باء is a past verb; بغضب is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to باء or to an omitted ḥāl; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. (وَمَأْواهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ): the wāw is resumptive or conjunctive; مأواه is a mubtadaʾ and جهنم its khabar (predicate); بئس is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; المصير is the fāʿil of بئس; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "their destination". (فَلَمْ تَقْتُلُوهُمْ وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ قَتَلَهُمْ): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (revealing an omitted condition), i.e. if you boast of having killed them, [know that] you did not kill them; so it has come as the apodosis of an implied condition. لم is a particle of negation, of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] and of the jussive; تقتلوهم is an imperfect verb in the jussive by لم. The wāw is a conjunction; لكنّ is a particle resembling the verb (one of the sisters of inna), and it has come in the best of ways, since it falls between a negation and an affirmation; الله is its noun and the clause قتلهم is its khabar. (وَما رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ رَمى): conjoined to what preceded; إذ is an adverb of past time attached to رميت; the wāw is conjunctive; لكنّ and its noun, and the clause رمى is its khabar. (وَلِيُبْلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ بَلاءً حَسَناً إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ): the wāw is conjunctive; the lām is causal; يبلي is an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied أن; أن together with what falls in its scope is in the position of a genitive by the lām, and both are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being:
"He did that". المؤمنين is a mafʿūl bihi; بلاء is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). البلاء here is understood as favour, because it applies to both favour and trial, since its root meaning is testing, and it is reducible to that; حسنا is a naʿt. إن الله سميع عليم is conjoined to what preceded: إنّ, its noun and its two khabars. (ذلِكُمْ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ الْكافِرِينَ): the i'rab of a parallel to the demonstrative has been given before: it is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "that testing is true"; وأن الله: أنّ together with what falls in its scope is conjoined to ذلكم; موهن is the khabar of «أنّ», and كيد الكافرين is annexed to موهن (muḍāf ilayhi). The reference is to the killing, the throwing and the testing. «أنّ» together with what falls in its scope may also be conjoined to «وليبلي», or be in the position of an accusative by an implied verb, i.e. "and know that Allah…".

* Rhetoric:
1- The device of taʿrīḍ (allusion, innuendo):
In the saying of Allah the Exalted «ومن يولهم يومئذ دبره» there is a device called taʿrīḍ, which some include under kināya (metonymy). al-Saʿd al-Taftāzānī said:
«When a kināya is allusive (ʿaraḍiyya), framed for the sake of a described person who is not mentioned, it is fitting to call it taʿrīḍ. One says: ʿarraḍtu li-fulān and ʿarraḍtu bi-fulān, when you say something while meaning him, as if you pointed to one side (ʿurḍ) while intending another side. From it come al-maʿārīḍ in speech, which is tawriya (double entendre), alluding by one thing to another.» al-Zamakhsharī said: «Kināya is to mention a thing by other than the word coined for it; taʿrīḍ is to mention something by which you indicate something you have not mentioned, as when the needy person says to the one he needs: "I have come to you to greet you". It is as if he inclined the speech towards a side (ʿurḍ) that points to the intended meaning; and the ʿurḍ of a thing, with ḍamma, is its side, from whichever direction you come to it.»
Ibn al-Athīr said in al-Mathal al-Sāʾir: «Kināya is what indicates a meaning that may be taken in the direction of both the literal (ḥaqīqa) and the figurative (majāz) by a quality common to both, and it occurs in single words and in compound expressions. Taʿrīḍ is the expression that indicates a meaning not by way of literal or figurative coinage, but by way of hinting and pointing; so it is specific to compound expressions, as in the saying of one who hopes for a gift: "By Allah, I am in need", for it is an allusive request although it was not coined for that either literally or figuratively; the meaning was understood from it only from the side (ʿurḍ) of the expression, i.e. its flank.»
Once you have understood this, it will be easy for you to recognise the secret of the taʿrīḍ in this elegant expression in the ayah: He mentioned to them a state that is considered shameful in the one who does it, and so He used the word الدبر (the backside) rather than الظهر (the back).
Abū al-Ṭayyib [al-Mutanabbī] was fond of this device. He said, alluding to Kāfūr al-Ikhshīdī:
ومن ركب الثور بعد الجوا ... د أنكر أظلافه والغبب
(Gloss: Whoever rides the ox after the steed finds its hooves and its dewlap strange.)
He means that one who rides the ox, while his habit was to ride the steed, finds the ox's hooves and dewlap strange; but one like Kāfūr, who had ridden the ox before, does not find that strange if he rides it after the steed. He also said, asking Kāfūr for more gifts after praising him:
أبا المسك هل في الكأس فضل أناله ... فإني أغني منذ حين وتشرب
(Gloss: O Abū al-Misk, is there anything left in the cup that I may obtain? For I have been singing for a while, and you drink.)
He is saying: my praise of you delights you as singing delights the drinker, so it is time that you give me to drink from what is left in your cup. Then he said after it:
وهبت على مقدار كفّي زماننا ... ونفسي على مقدار كفّيك تطلب
(Gloss: You have given according to the measure of the palms of our time, while my soul asks according to the measure of your palms.)
2- The device of istidrāk (rectification) and rujūʿ (retraction):
It is speech containing the word «لكن». It is of two kinds: a kind in which the istidrāk is preceded by an affirmation, and a kind in which it is not. Of the second kind is the saying of Allah the Exalted: «فلم تقتلوهم ولكن الله قتلهم، وما رميت إذ رميت ولكن الله رمى». The istidrāk has come in these words in two places, each of which is prepared for taʿaṭṭuf (the turning back of a word upon itself), for the words تقتلوهم and قتلهم, and رميت and رمى, turn back upon each other.
This is the closest istidrāk that has occurred in speech, because its particle stands in the middle between the two words of taʿaṭṭuf in both places. An example of the first kind will come shortly.
Among what has come of it in poetry is the saying of Abū al-Ṭayyib:
هم المحسنون الكرّ في حومة الوغى ... وأحسن منه كرّهم في المكارم
ولولا احتقار الأسد شبّهتها بهم ... لكنّها معدودة في البهائم
(Gloss: They are the ones who excel at charging in the thick of battle, and better still is their charging in noble deeds; were it not for contempt of lions I would have likened them to them, but lions are counted among the beasts.)
And how beautiful is the saying of one of them about a head crucified on a spear:
وعاد لكنّه رأس بلا جسد ... يمشي ولكن على ساق بلا قدم
إذا تراءى على الخطي أسفر في ... حال العبوس لنا عن ثغر مبتسم
(Gloss: He returned, but as a head without a body, walking, but on a shank without a foot; when he appears upon the spear, in the midst of grimness he reveals to us a smiling mouth.)

* Benefits:
History relates that on the day of Uḥud, Ubayy ibn Khalaf began galloping his horse until he came near the Messenger of Allah ﷺ. Some of the Muslim men stood in the way of Ubayy ibn Khalaf to kill him, but the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to them: "Stand back", so they stood back. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ took his short spear in his hand and threw it at Ubayy ibn Khalaf, breaking one of his ribs. Ubayy ibn Khalaf went back to his companions weighed down, and they carried him as they turned back to go home, and they began to say: "No harm." When they said that to him, Ubayy said: "By Allah, had it been on all the people, it would have killed them. Did he not say: I will kill you, if Allah wills?" His companions set off with him, trying to revive him, until he died somewhere on the road and they buried him. Ibn al-Musayyab said: and concerning that Allah revealed:
«وما رميت إذ رميت».

dervis-irab:19-23.t:
* Vocabulary:
(تَسْتَفْتِحُوا): you seek the fatḥ, i.e. the judgement and decision between you and Muḥammad, by giving victory to the one in the right and forsaking the one in the wrong. It is related that when they wanted to set out, they clung to the curtains of the Kaʿba and said: "O Allah, whichever of us cut the ties of kinship more and brought us what we do not know, then فأحنه (bring him to ruin) this morning", i.e. destroy him.
(الدَّوَابِّ): the plural of دابّة (creature). What is meant by it here is the human being. Applying دابّة to the human being is literal (ḥaqīqī), because of what they mention in the books of language, namely that it is applied to every animal, even a human. In al-Miṣbāḥ: الدابة is every living creature on the earth, whether endowed with discernment or not.

* I'rab:
(إِنْ تَسْتَفْتِحُوا فَقَدْ جاءَكُمُ الْفَتْحُ): إن is conditional; تستفتحوا is an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is the linking fāʾ (rābiṭa) because the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is joined with قد; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); جاءكم الفتح is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent). (وَإِنْ تَنْتَهُوا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمْ): conjoined to what preceded, and the i'rab is like what came before it. The apodosis is joined with the fāʾ because it is a nominal clause composed of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and a khabar (predicate). The apodosis clause in both places is in the position of a jussive. (وَإِنْ تَعُودُوا نَعُدْ): also conjoined.
The apodosis clause has no grammatical position. (وَلَنْ تُغْنِيَ عَنْكُمْ فِئَتُكُمْ شَيْئاً وَلَوْ كَثُرَتْ): also conjoined; فئتكم is the fāʿil of تغني; شيئا is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) or a mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is circumstantial; لو is conditional; كثرت is the protasis, and the apodosis is omitted.
(وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ): also conjoined. The hamza of «أنّ» takes fatḥa by implying the lām; the implied form is ولأنّ الله مع المؤمنين (and because Allah is with the believers). الله is the noun of أنّ, and مع is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted word which is the khabar. (يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا): its i'rab has been given before. (أَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَلا تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ وَأَنْتُمْ تَسْمَعُونَ): أطيعوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; الله is a mafʿūl bihi and رسوله is conjoined to الله; the clause ولا تولوا is conjoined to the clause أطيعوا; لا is prohibitive; تولوا is an imperfect in the jussive by the prohibitive لا, the wāw being the fāʿil; عنه is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تولوا; وأنتم: the wāw is circumstantial, أنتم is a mubtadaʾ and the clause تسمعون is the khabar. (وَلا تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ قالُوا سَمِعْنا وَهُمْ لا يَسْمَعُونَ): conjoined to what preceded. The kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), the khabar of تكونوا; and it is a preposition, the preposition and its genitive noun being the khabar [Translator's note: the source gives both analyses side by side in this way, presumably as alternatives]. The clause قالوا is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause سمعنا is the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl); the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause هم لا يسمعون is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
